do: Give every Store page one job: a product family, a use case, or a brand story, with one clear next click.
dont: Do not build a Store page as a wall of every SKU with no hierarchy.
why: Stores convert when the page answers a single question; a flat catalogue wastes the visit.

do: Use the brand story module to state who makes the product, where, and what standard it meets.
dont: Do not use unverifiable superlatives or badges the brand has not earned.
why: Provenance and standards are what differentiate a private label from a commodity listing.
source: Amazon Seller Central - brand story module
